holderQuote: Kenjiro stumbled back into camp too tired to walk properly and reeking of filth. As his head hit the ground he heard a voice in his head. It had a surprise for him.
Ken had told Luan and Aiko about it immediately of course, but no one else. He hadn’t known it was a class you could get, but it made sense. And the Skills he’d gotten!
Ken had tried to use it, but apparently it was a passive Skill rather than one he could use.
effectQuote: It seemed to help with his ability to speak English, and perhaps other languages, if he knew them.

holderQuote: It was most likely due to his Skill, [Amateur Linguist].
effectQuote: Thanks to it, Ken had understood exactly what had been written.
